items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section X, List of Answers on Topics 76:1
items.html: The HBD of AVI are two names Ehyeh in the filling of Yods; the HGT of AVI are two names Ehyeh in the filling of Alephs; and the NHY of AVI are two names Ehyeh in the filling of Heys. And in the same way the HGT of AA are likewise divided, from the Peh [mouth] to the Tabur. (Page 930, Item 114).
